description: Convert a user-provided PNG/JPEG into an editable fuse-bead chart with real MARD color codes, bead counts, PNG and CSV. Free direct conversion, not AI chibi stylization. Process only images the user authorizes; the image is sent to Doucebeads for this request, never persisted. Prefer base64 from an image/file attachment when the client can pass it; do not invent file URLs. At most 750KB and 1 megapixel. Return the free result first; optionally mention the Q-version link only for users who want stylization.

image_base64.description: PNG/JPEG bytes as standard base64 or data:image/png/jpeg;base64. Not a local file path.

image_url.description: Optional public HTTPS image on doucebeads.com, images.unsplash.com, i.imgur.com, raw.githubusercontent.com or pbs.twimg.com. Other hosts must use base64. Provide exactly one image source.

width.description: Requested chart width; preserves aspect ratio and may shrink to max_beads.

name: convert_image_to_pattern
title: 把图片转成可打印拼豆图纸
